beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:f4.title: Generalist / Portco Recruiter
beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:f4.description: Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com/ is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies. They are niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore. Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently, accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable. We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better. Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game. ABOUT THE ROLE Fresh off a $225M Series C, we're acquiring companies at pace and the hiring demand that comes with it is real. As we scale, we are looking to build our in-house business and G&A recruiting function, while also expanding our talent offerings to our portcos. This is a unique, multi-faceted role for a superstar generalist recruiter who can run full-cycle searches across finance, sales, marketing, operations, HR, and customer success, both at Beacon's corporate team and inside our portfolio companies. What You'll be Doing: - Full-cycle ownership, corporate side. Support hiring for non-eng/non-product roles at Beacon HQ, including finance, marketing, sales, ops, M&A, and BD, from first outreach to signed offer. - Portco hiring on demand. Parachute into a portfolio company's one-off senior hire - e.g. a Product Marketing Manager, a Head of Sales, an Ops lead - learn the business quickly, and run the search end-to-end alongside a GM who may never have worked with a dedicated recruiter before. - Constant context-switching. Juggle multiple open roles at once across different functions, companies, and markets, each with its own comp band, hiring bar, and stakeholder. - Strategic partnership. Build hiring plans with GMs and functional leaders at as both a thought and recruiting partner - Creative sourcing. LinkedIn is the floor, not the ceiling. Functional networks, referrals, niche communities, and AI-assisted tooling are all in play, and the right channel changes with every role. - Operational rigor. We use Ashby and we take our data seriously. Clean pipelines, tight feedback loops, and disciplined processes are essential. - The close. You know how to navigate comp conversations and competing offers with ease and drive negotiations to a successful close. - Brand building. You'll help tell the Beacon story in markets and functions we haven't actively recruited in before. What you Bring: - 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience with a generalist background, comfortable calibrating fast on, and recruiting for roles and industries you haven't extensively recruited for. - Comfort in high-growth, multi-entity environments. You don't need a playbook for every function; you're happy to write one. - A fast learner. You can get conversant in an unfamiliar function or industry quickly enough to calibrate talent without a hiring manager holding your hand. - Verbal and written communication that's authentic, polished, persuasive. - Self-direction. You know how to prioritize across a shifting slate of roles and deliver without being supervised. - Hands-on experience with Ashby or Greenho

jobgether-jobgether:lever:021fc748-4bb4-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Project Coordinator based in United Kingdom. As a Senior Project Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting site activation and site-level deliverables throughout the clinical trial lifecycle. You will collaborate closely with Project Managers, Clinical Trial Managers, Site Selection teams, CRAs, clinical sites, and other stakeholders. The role combines project coordination, regulatory documentation, communication, and operational oversight in a global, multi-regional environment. You will take ownership of timelines, quality, and priorities to help ensure sites are activated efficiently and trials remain on track. As a senior team member, you will work autonomously while also supporting and mentoring junior colleagues when needed. This is an opportunity to make a tangible impact in a fast-growing clinical research environment while contributing to the successful delivery of clinical trials. Coordinate site activation activities from site selection through activation, ensuring timelines, targets, and deliverables meet internal and external expectations. Prepare investigator sites for clinical trials by reviewing, collecting, approving, filing, and tracking essential clinical and regulatory documentation. Establish site activation timelines with selected sites and coordinate activities across stakeholders to achieve planned activation milestones. Serve as a key point of contact for clinical sites during site start-up, maintaining clear communication and ensuring priorities remain aligned with study timelines. Collaborate with Project Managers, Clinical Trial Managers, CRAs, Site Selection teams, and other functional departments to coordinate activities and resolve issues. Ensure the electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) contains complete, accurate, and appropriate regulatory documentation for site activation and ongoing study management. Support local ethics submissions and assist sites with regulatory and administrative requirements. Collect and distribute documents and study correspondence between sites and internal teams, while maintaining study files and required tracking logs. Coordinate internal project-specific training, including document assignments, reconciliation, and training documentation. Maintain project timelines, enrollment tracking tools, study material inventories, and other project tracking systems. Prepare meeting minutes, status reports, project updates, and other administrative documentation required by the project team. Support the preparation and shipment of study supplies and Investigator Study Files to clinical sites, where applicable. Assist with Investigators’ Meetings and provide in-house support to CRAs when they are traveling. Review and reconcile investigator site and vendor payments. Provide support for Health Authority inspections, pre-inspection activities, audits, and the preparation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) when required. Contribute to process improvement initiatives and the development of training materials within the Site Activation and Project Coordination function. Take on selected project management responsibilities when assigned and support broader project objectives as required. Mentor junior Project Coordinators and contribute to onboarding and knowledge-sharing activities. At least 2 years of experience as a Project Coordinator or in an equivalent clinical research position within the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and/or CRO industry. jobgether-jobgether:lever:0d780459-af2b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Strong consultative and solution-selling capabilities, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to business outcomes and ROI. Flexible time off and sick time. 10 company holiday

jobgether-jobgether:lever:9b042206-0a7f-.title: Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:9b042206-0a7f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist based in Turkey. This is a senior creative role focused on shaping intuitive, expressive, and highly engaging interfaces for mobile games enjoyed by players around the world. You will define the visual identity of the game UI while building scalable systems that keep experiences consistent across devices and screen sizes. The role combines visual design, UX thinking, prototyping, design systems, and close collaboration with game development teams. You will transform concepts into polished interfaces, seamlessly blending 2D UI with 3D game assets while maintaining strong hierarchy and visual impact. You will also contribute to modern AI-assisted workflows that accelerate ideation, exploration, and asset creation. Success requires both artistic excellence and a systems mindset, with a strong understanding of mobile gaming conventions and player behavior. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact in a fast-moving, remote-friendly environment where creativity, experimentation, and collaboration are highly valued. Define and own the visual direction, layout, interaction patterns, and overall artistic quality of mobile game interfaces. Create high-fidelity 2D UI assets, icons, screens, menus, and interactive elements that are colorful, polished, intuitive, and optimized for mobile devices. Integrate 2D UI layers with 3D game assets while maintaining visual hierarchy, depth, readability, and a cohesive aesthetic. Build, scale, and maintain a component-driven UI design system in Figma, including reusable components, variants, variables, auto-layout structures, and responsive behaviors. Design modular and reusable UI components that account for mobile platform constraints and different screen sizes and aspect ratios. Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, interactive prototypes, and iconography that prioritize intuitive navigation, touch ergonomics, and engaging player interactions. Design interfaces for modern free-to-play meta systems, including progression tracks, Battle Passes, collection systems, rewards, and other engagement features. Collaborate closely with programmers, technical artists, producers, and other creative stakeholders to ensure designs are implemented accurately and retain their intended visual quality in-engine. Use generative AI and AI-assisted design tools to accelerate brainstorming, mood-board development, concept exploration, iteration, and asset generation. Maintain clear design documentation and communicate UI logic and design-system principles effectively to technical and creative teams. Contribute to UI animations, visual effects, and other implementation considerations where appropriate. Continuously refine the player experience by balancing visual excitement with clarity, usability, consistency, and performance. Requirements 10+ years of professional game-art experience, including at least 5 years specializing in UI/UX art. A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional mobile game UI/UX work, including visual case studies or references from at least 2 shipped mobile titles. Excellent understanding of composition, color theory, typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and stylized 2D game-art production. Deep knowledge of mobile game UI principles, including touch interfaces, gesture controls, ergonomics, and iOS/Android design considerations. Strong understanding of free-to-play game meta systems such as Battle Passes, progression tracks, collection systems, and reward loops. Expert-level proficiency with Figma, including auto-layout, nested components, variables, variants, design systems, and interactive prototyping. Strong proficiency with Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for high-fidelity asset creation, iconography, vectors, textures, and visual treatments. Proven experience creating and managing comprehensive UI design systems and style

matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:be908eda-1ae.title: Product Manager (Match Group AI)
matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:be908eda-1ae.description: Match Group AI Team Introduction Match Group AI (MG AI) is the central tech organization that drives innovation across Match Group's global portfolio, including Tinder, Hinge, Azar, Pairs, Match, BLK, etc. Match Group aims to spark meaningful connections for everyone, worldwide, and the MG AI team's role is to bring cutting-edge AI to unblock the challenges along that journey, across diverse domains (e.g., Recommendation, Trust & Safety, Profile Enhancement). Unlike brand-specific teams (e.g., Tinder, HYPERCONNECT AI), MG AI team offers the unique opportunity to impact the entire Match Group ecosystem. You won't just build for one app; we aim to develop scalable AI solutions that power Tinder, Hinge, and beyond, defining the technological gold standard for the global dating industry. Detailed article: Introduction to Match Group AI Team (written in Korean) Working as a Product Manager at MG AI While engineers focus on building and shipping models, Product Managers at MG AI own the why and the what. We translate complex, often ambiguous business challenges from Match Group's brands into clear ML product strategy, and we drive execution across a globally distributed team. The PMs who thrive here are strategic troubleshooters with a bias for action: they spot what is blocking progress and drive it to resolution instead of waiting. This is a communication-first role, but that does not mean coordination alone. Your core job is to figure out which problem is worth solving, articulate it in clear and precise language, and drive alignment among a diverse set of stakeholders across cultures and time zones. You own the product thinking end to end: framing the problem, shaping the plan, and defining what we build. You will work on projects that leverage a wide range of technologies, from on-device ML modules to server-side AI models and LLMs. You do not need to be an ML expert on day one, but you must learn fast and become technically fluent enough to make sound product calls, because the technology and the problems keep changing.
responsibilities: Frame the Problem: Figure out which problems are worth solving and why, and articulate them in clear, precise language that a diverse team can rally around.
Shape the Roadmap: Decide what matters most, sequence the work, make the tradeoffs, and write PRDs, keeping partners aligned as priorities shift.

Navigate Complex Stakeholder Maps: Act as the connective tissue between Match Group's brands, and the many functions within them, and MG AI engineering. Read the unspoken dynamics, build alignment across brands, functions, cultures, and time zones, and keep everyone moving in the same direction.

Hands-on Execution: Stay deeply involved in the details. Use experiments, behavioral data, and research to guide your calls when signals are imperfect, unblock engineering, and make the small decisions that keep a project moving.
qualifications: Exceptional Communication & Stakeholder Management (most important): You excel at managing stakeholders in complex, high-ambiguity situations. You read between the lines, sense interpersonal and organizational dynamics, and build alignment across teams with competing priorities. This is the single most important quality for this role.
4-6 years of product management experience in the Tech domain, ideally on complex systems or data or ML-driven products.

Fast Learning Curve & Strong Will to Learn: You do not need to be ML-savvy today, but you must ramp quickly and become technically fluent enough to shape direction on model behavior and tradeoffs without needing to be deeply technical.
Fluent in English (Able to conduct business meetings and participate in complex discussions without requiring assistance.)
Fluent in Korean (Sophisticated professional interactions with native-level precision and an understanding of cultural nuances.) Essential for cross-functional collaboration within the Seoul office.

Strong Ownership & Bias for Action: A track record of driving problems to resolution without waiting for permission. You are comfortable operating with ambiguity and making principled calls when the signals are imperfect.
Analytical Rigor: Comfort with data. You can define metrics, design and read experiments, and let evidence guide your decisions.
Global Operational Readiness: Ability to accommodate flexible working hours for regular early morning syncs with US teams (EST/PST).
A Point of View on AI Tooling: A clear sense of how AI tools can raise the quality and speed of product work, and a habit of using them (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor).
ML Product Experience: Exposure to ML-driven products (Recommendation, Search, Ranking, or Trust & Safety) and a working understanding of the ML lifecycle, from data to online A/B testing.
Matching Products Experience: Experience with products that match people or content (e.g., dating, marketplaces, social feeds, or hiring).
Internal Platform / B2B2C Experience: Success in a role where your primary customers were other internal business units or engineering teams.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Experience working with diverse, globally distributed teams and organizations.
